propositions: pytest-xdist worker crashes with 'node down: Not properly terminated' on the test_matching_guard_is_accepted test intermittently in CI on Python 3.11 only
asyncio.wait_for consumes external cancellation when its child completes in the same event-loop turn, leaving the worker task in a cancelling state and blocking on queue.get()
replacing asyncio.wait_for(asyncio.to_thread(...), timeout=…) with async context manager asyncio.timeout(...) restores correct cancellation semantics
the defect was already fixed by commit 8c9bf5d78d which replaced the flawed wait_for pattern and added regression tests
xdist teardown races under CPU contention cause OSError during worker channel closure, reproduced when suite runs under artificial load pressure
